row.name: Ilysia
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord Community About the Game Aenor… once a thriving island, lost to ash and ruin. The fire elementals, led by the enraged Guardian Bal’Ramos, rose without warning, consuming all in their path. The skies darkened, the land split, and despite the efforts of brave heroes, hope burned away with the flames. But not all was lost. A handful of survivors fled, their hearts heavy with loss yet fueled by fragile determination. Through storm and peril, they sought refuge and found it here, in Lavea —a second chance. With the kindness of its people and the resilience of their own, the survivors begin anew. But rebuilding comes at a price, for darkness is never truly vanquished. Whispers of ancient power stir beneath the surface, and as new threats rise, so too must new heroes—blade in hand, bow drawn, and spell woven— to stand against the coming storm and shape the fate of these lands. A New World Awaits The story continues in Ilysia , a VR MMORPG set in the newly discovered land of Lavea. Picking up after the fall of Aenor, the survivors now strive to reestablish themselves—but new dangers rise to challenge them. Venture forth alone or with allies as you embark on quests, grow in level,  hone your skills, learn new trades, and tackle dangerous challenges as you gain power in an ever-evolving online world. Whether you seek glory in combat, riches through crafting, or the thrill of exploration, your journey is yours to forge. Join us in Early Access and help shape the future of this evolving world. Group & Social Systems – Form parties, communicate through in-game voice channels and mail , and take on challenges together. Dungeons & Elite Encounters – Party up for instanced dungeons and world bosses , or face them alone—if you dare. Quests & Story-Driven Adventure – Embark on quests solo or with friends , uncovering the secrets of Lavea. Combat Your Way – Wield blades, bows, or spells to strike down enemies or support allies with healing magic. Whether you prefer close-quarters combat or long-range tactics , your skills shape the battle. Character Customization – Choose from a variety of races and personalize every detail of your character. Crafting & Professions – Master fishing, cooking, armorsmithing, and weaponsmithing to craft and trade valuable gear. Rewarding Exploration – Uncover hidden treasures, dangerous foes, and diverse challenges , including quests, dungeons, and elite encounters. Freedom of Movement – Climb walls, scale cliffs, leap across gaps, swim through rivers, sprint across open terrain, and glide over vast landscapes —traverse Ilysia your way. Fast Travel – Ride open-world airships for breathtaking views or use your Rune of Returning to quickly reach your destination.
row.short_description: Venture forth alone or with allies in a classic high fantasy VR MMORPG as you embark on quests, grow in power, hone your skills, learn new trades, and tackle dangerous challenges as you gain power in the ever-evolving online world of Ilysia!

row.name: Evrisia Art
row.detailed_description: Evrisia Art is a VR based painting program intended to help introduce new users to VR and to feel comfortable using the Steam VR VIVE controllers and system. PC / VIVE only, it allows the person in VR to paint shapes all around them, but also allows the computer operator to guide them while inside the experience, as well as changing settings to make it simpler or easier to use depending on their skillset. Available to anyone who meets the requirements of the HTC Vive System. Evrisia Art is integrated into the Evrisia Eye testing system.
row.short_description: Evrisia Art is a VR painting program that can help introduce new users to Virtual Reality in a fun, relaxed and easy to use way. By drawing simple shapes, new users can immediately get a sense of control over their environment without having to learn complex tools.

row.name: Rambunny
row.detailed_description: When a quiet family of rabbits is abducted by evil space foxes, only a brave rabbit can help. Join in an adventure with hidden traps, escape from a fireball rains, drive a scooter, face a giant fox robot, explore caves, fly in a rocket and defeat the evil boss to bring the bunnies home! Rambunny is a 2D platform game with moderate difficulty, containing 10 stages divided into small dungeons. Want More!? Infinite lives Cutscenes Easter Eggs Cute Bunnies Hidden Traps Pixel Art Funny Hero Nonsense plot Scooter and Rocket Stage Steam Achievements Evil Galactic Boss Own Language in Balloons Cheap Game
row.short_description: Join in an adventure with hidden traps, escape from a fireball rains, drive a scooter, face a giant fox robot, explore caves, fly in a rocket and defeat the evil boss to bring the bunnies home!

row.name: Tech Support 2077
row.detailed_description: Before Richard Stallman 2.0 disappeared from the Virtual Web, never to be seen again, he distributed a groundbreaking new manifesto called Raptor. It was said to be so open and free and beard-strokingly-good that so much as retweeting it could irreversibly destroy the concept of paid software forever. In response, the wealthy United Peace Corporation of tech giants created B.O.M.B. - the Big Ol' Malware Bomb, a suite of bugs, viruses, worms, and overly-helpful paperclips that eventually wiped out all traces of Raptor. Years later a few devout Stallmanites have tracked down the last remaining copy of Raptor, and need your help to salvage it before B.O.M.B. arrives. You and a tech support wizard named Diver will be injected into the motherboard of an ancient Windows Phone, found deep under the ocean where it was presumably hurled when the buyer's remorse set in. Wield a revolver and a plasma sword against ten waves of unique robotic enemies. Protect Diver while he retrieves the legacy of Stallman, then escape with your artificial lives!
row.short_description: You are an AI sent to battle an overwhelming tide of computer viruses and malware - in VR! Shoot them with your explodo-revolver, or slash them down with waves of deadly energy from your plasma sword, and if they get too close you'll have to beat them back with your bare hands!

row.name: RPG Character Builder
row.detailed_description: An easy to use tool which uses free, open art, allowing you to easily make thousands of unique character sprite sheets for your game or project. Based on the Universal LPC Sprite Sheet project which is a free, open source project aimed at providing free character art for 2D games. Made for instant import into the RPGMaker MV engine. All output files are simply PNG spritesheets, so if you are making your game in another engine you should be able to figure out how to use them in your engine with a small amount of effort.
row.short_description: An easy to use tool which uses free, open art, allowing you to easily make thousands of unique character sprite sheets for your game or project.
row.notes: The default character sheet starts out with no clothes on. Not exactly "nudity" (i.e. there are no private parts depicted), but technically they are starter sprites without any cloth assets overlaid on them.

row.name: The Magician's Research
row.detailed_description: The MAGICIAN'S RESEARCH is an RPG style IDLE - INCREMENTAL - MANAGEMENT Game! The Experiments of the Mage's Guild have broken out and you are tasked with tracking down, researching, and disposing of them before they can disturb the nearby towns or multiply! Choose between 10 MAGICIANS with unique bonuses to play. Unlock Support slots to use more than a primary mage to make a party of bonuses. Click Enemies, Heal Yourself, Use Potions! (Or use the AUTO-CLICKS if you’d like). Auto Move that magically toggles on for you while you’re away. (If you want). Expand your power through the SKILL TREE by leveling your Magician Donate ARCANE SCRAP to the Mage’s Guild for Rewards. Complete numerous QUESTS and Campaign Quests that reset Weekly and can be found as extras! Spend Liquid Gold on Magical Upgrades. Trade Runes, Dragon Eggs, and Cursed Amulets for even more power! Combine Ingredients in the Alchemy Lab to create buffs! Gain Reputation with each Faction for extra PERMANENT bonuses! Go back in time resetting to only HALF of your max Stages reached NOT STARTING AT the very beginning! Gain 2 different prestige currencies for extra power, plus permanent bonuses. Choose between pushing and prestiging more or less often depending on your preferences. Earn Trophies Unlock Badges for MORE Permanent rewards! Offline Gains for up to 7 Days! Offline progression to help with busy lives! Idle chest that gives some extra loot for your play time! Daily Login Rewards Weekly Login Rewards Leaderboards! You’re on your way to the Mage’s Guild as the newest recruitee when you run into Aliseth the Master of the Mage’s Guild. He informs you that somehow the magical experiments of the mage’s tower have broken free and seems to be magically multiplying by the moment. He needs every able body out to research and then dispose of the experiments before they can disturb the nearby towns or duplicate infinitely! You, being the eager Mage-ling you are, decide to oblige your new boss and head off into the fields of the surrounding areas to slay some mighty beasties! Well… Now that’s the question isn’t it? Choose from one of 10 magician’s , each with their own special bonuses! (You can change at any time ). Play as the one you think looks the best, the one with your favorite bonus, or be a changeling and flip around as they suit your situation. You can then unlock SUPPORT slots where you can use other mages but at half of their normal power. This lets you combo some of their bonuses to create your custom gameplay style. Unlock up to 4 additional slots for a total of 5 mages to mix together. Well you and the enemy both have health , so be careful! You’ll want to try to stay alive to get to the next experiments to research. You can tap the enemy with a left click to do damage. If your health gets low you can click heal yourself or drink a health potion! Use DPS potions for extra short term damage and energy regen for extra clicking! (Automation: You can also use the auto-clicks that will click for you - There's even a Mage that can help those do more damage! The auto-move will attempt to progress you forward every 30 minutes until you’re defeated again). You give it to someone who wants it, but don’t give it for free! Make sure they give you something to make you a better Mage!! Always try to be a better Mage. At the TRADERS you can trade Liquid Gold, Runes, and Dragon Eggs. These all have different advantages. Dragon Eggs give powerful buffs with low caps and the unspent Dragon Eggs stay with you through Time Shifting. Runes give small bonuses but you'll find a lot more of them, you trade them to the fairies for Boons that stack up and up and up. Liquid Gold powers up your Spells. These are your main source of progression, they give you health, damage, defense, loot bonuses, clicking, and more! Every TRADER gets a PERMANENT bonus too! They're called WINDOW FACTIONS. You get them just for using the Traders! You trade in enough goods with them and they just give you a bonus. Trade in enough liquid gold and you'll find yourself finding more. Trade in enough Dragon Eggs, they might magically not reset when you time shift! Watch out for that Curse Eater though, she may be cute but she’s super scary! Who puts a bow on a pink skull? ...Who has a pink skull?? She'll take your Cursed Amulets you find and trade them in for all kinds of extra loot. They're cursed so they like to cling to you, they don't reset on Time Shifting either. Go find some more experiments! Get stronger, do more research. Level up and get some skill points. Spend them to get good bonuses from the SKILL TREE . Be careful of those ELITE EXPERIMENTS though. They might have some cool rewards but they hurt! You don't need to be here all the time either! Tab out, take a break, come back and see your Mage doing his or her job fighting the baddies! Spend all that loot they have saved up for you and watch them burst down some enemies in a haze. In The Magician's Research when you Rebirth/Prestige it's called Time Shifting and you only go back to HALF of the max stages you've ever reached instead of starting ALLLL the way back at the very beginning. Why waste all that time climbing back up? You still get to burst down some mobs and feel epic but then you get to get back to the fight and whack some baddies much sooner! The prestige currencies in the game come in two shapes and both stack up everytime you Time Shift: You have one that rewards your pushing called KNOWLEDGE POINTS . You get these for every new Mage Level you reach. Every first time you reach a new Mage Level you get one of these bad boys to add to the pool. These increase your experience yields for ALLL future runs . So essentially every time you get more knowledge points you level faster getting you back up to where you were faster! Then you have your 'farming' reward called MONSTER POPULATION . You get these for EVERY stage you pass every Time Shift you go through! They increase your health and damage permanently for all future runs too. You even get bonuses to that run's gains every 250 Stages you pass. AND after you time shift and you start at that HALF your max stages EVER reached, you get a starting booster bonus to your gains so you're not missing out on what you would have earned if you had started from Stage 0 (and you get it much quicker than if you had to start all over again!). Between the two currencies you can shoot back up and push push push. If you're starting to slow down you have two options. If you're really tenacious you can wait for another mage level or more Liquid Gold, Runes, etc and push out a few more Stages or hit a burst of power and grab some more Knowledge points, or time shift and try for more Monster Population and store your bonuses that you gained from your last run. Time Shift more, or less ,depending on how you like to play, slow and steady, fast and furious, or somewhere in between! This game is all about playing how you like to play and finding your own pace and strategy for your idle and management experience. We hope you enjoy! Get stronger, go further! Keep at it! We have faith you’ll be the strongest Magician ever! (Hopefully).
row.short_description: The MAGICIAN'S RESEARCH is an RPG style IDLE - INCREMENTAL - MANAGEMENT Game! The Experiments of the Mage's Guild have broken out and you are tasked with tracking down, researching, and disposing of them before they can disturb the nearby towns or multiply!

row.name: Mythic Ocean: Prologue
row.detailed_description: What would you do if you were friends with the gods, and your influence on them could change the universe? Mythic Ocean: Prologue will introduce you to a pantheon of gods under the sea. Experience the first 3 branching storylines of Mythic Ocean, and pick up where you left off when you play the full game! Explore the outcomes. Which god will gain the most power? You decide - choose wisely. Features Narrative Exploration - combines the dialog-focused gameplay of a Visual Novel with free-roaming exploration. Unlock a unique conversation that doesn't appear in the full game. Diverse, peaceful underwater environments. Meet tons of goofy, charming creatures. No death, no combat, no failure. The challenge is influencing the gods to get the result you want - outcomes range between harmony and pandemonium. There's a breakdancing crab.
row.short_description: Get to know the gods! This preview will give you a first glimpse into the world of Mythic Ocean, a narrative exploration game where your choices shape the fate of the cosmos.

row.name: Drone Wars
row.detailed_description: Our goal with drone wars is it to create a fun, simple, but unique and fair multiplayer experience. What you can expect from this game: Controlling the drone is simple and easy, so no flight training needed, just jump right in and have fun! No one-shot weapons. Under normal circumstances there are no one-shot weapons, so you always have the chance to put up a fight if you get attacked from behind. The game currently supports 7 different game modes, but there will probably be more in the future. Drone: Team deathmatch Drones vs Humans: Team deathmatch Drones vs Humans: Wipeout - Survive as human until a rescue force arrives, or as a drone try to kill all the remaining humans before the timer runs out. Every dying human ends up as a drone. Drone: Arena - Last drone flying Drone: Deathmatch Drone: Capture Points - Capture and defend the capture-points Human: Team Deathmatch After each game mode, you will have the option to vote for the next game mode (can be disabled by server admins) Your feedback is important to us, so we can let the community help improve our games. We welcome you to share your thoughts with us via the steam forums or discord, and the development surveys we host.
row.short_description: Drone Wars is a simple but unique multiplayer Sci-Fi first-person shooter, where you can play as a heavily armed combat drone or as a human special task force soldier.

row.name: Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces
row.detailed_description: You may also like About the Game Be a pioneer of aerial warfare in Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces. Fight above the battlefields of World War I and become the ultimate Sky Ace! The game will take you into the times when aviation was in its dawning of existence – the first Wright brothers machines went into the sky just 11 years before the Great War! Engineers were quickly adapting this brand new invention into military purposes while creating fascinating and sometimes oddly looking planes. In Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces you take control of over 30 historical airplanes – including the Fokker Dr.I, famous for its pilot Manfred von Richthofen a.k.a. “Red Baron”. Others stemming from light fighters like the Airco DH.2 to an enormous 4-engine bomber like the Sikorsky Ilya Muromets – all planes can be customized and upgraded. Choose between two modes suited for different playstyles and skillsets. In Pilot Mode you can simply focus on air combat, collecting and upgrading planes. Squadron Leader Mode adds an extra layer to the gameplay – apart from combat, you also need to manage resources, hire and train pilots and expand your base. Two campaigns for Triple Entente and one for Central Powers will let you experience all major fronts of World War I – you’ll fly above most countries that participated in the conflict in various types of mission. Pilot fighters and bombers. Protect or destroy ground targets. Face mighty zeppelins and anti aircraft artillery to change the tides of war. BECOME A SKY ACE Experience WWI aerial warfare with intuitive controls and user-friendly flight mechanics. Choose between fun-to-play Pilot Mode or a more advanced Squadron Leader Mode. Collect over 30 historical planes from World War I. 3 campaigns set in all parts of the world. Various types of missions and tasks.
row.short_description: Be a pioneer of aerial warfare in Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces. Fight above the battlefields of World War I and become the ultimate Sky Ace!

row.name: VITAL
row.detailed_description: The game VITAL is a first person puzzle platformer taking place in a dream world. You have no idea where you are or how you got there. The only thing that is certain is that someone or something doesn't want you to wake up. Explore the mind of a fragile individual and solve physics-based puzzles. Every step forward is one step closer to the truth. Features Explore a beautiful and bizarre world Over 20 levels with multiple challenging physics-based puzzles Use gravity, force, expanding and shrinking objects to progress deeper into the world Story driven gameplay, talk with eccentric and weird characters and read notes to find out what's going on Multiple endings Steam achievements
row.short_description: VITAL is a first person puzzle platformer taking place in a dream world. You have no idea where you are or how you got there. The only thing that is certain is that someone or something doesn't want you to wake up. Explore the mind of a fragile individual and solve physics-based puzzles.

row.name: Santa's Visit
row.detailed_description: Become Santa Claus and explore about the cozy living area of a family's home on the eve of Christmas. Look for clues and hints as to what each family member most enjoys and take your time choosing just the right gift for each - and while you're at it, have yourself a merry little bit of playtime and personally test each of the available gifts! Fly a Quad-Copter Drone or an RC Zeppelin, zip around with an RC Sports Car, read a heart-warming Christmas classic on an eReader Tablet, pop on some Holiday tunes with the portable Smart Speaker, and lots more! Or maybe just sit back and watch a vintage Christmas movie or two while Santa takes a much deserved milk & cookies break! Warm up in this cozy little Christmas wonderland any time of the year!
row.short_description: Discover you inner Santa Claus in this Virtual Holiday Experience! Take a ride across the world and then through Mistletoe County, leading up to the Smiths house. It's up to you to decide if they have been naughty or nice this year. Choose the right gifts and cause some mayhem before you leave!

row.name: HOME: Our Journey
row.detailed_description: Explore the Solar System! Stand next to the Sun and gain perspective for the true vastness of space beyond our home planet. You're in control of this virtual orrery. Fast-forward and rewind time itself as you highlight planetary orbits and discover a bit more about your nearest celestial neighbors. Are you curious to know how the planets were aligned on your birthday? Want to check out specific moments of celestial alignment? Hopefully, because that's about it for the moment. Enjoy! HOME is not a complete experience: It is very much a current work-in-progress. It is being built with, and for the moment has only been tested on, the Vive HMD with generation one ‘wand’ controllers. Other headsets and controllers may currently work, but I haven't yet put any effort into testing if they do. HOME is an interactive section of a larger experience currently in active development: Updates will be pushed out as more sections are fleshed out. Future versions will expand on the current Solar System model as well as add deeper dives into our home planet and the other planets in our Solar System. Please, send me feedback. I've made the development process public at this stage to encourage a feedback cycle. Are there any celestial bodies you would like to see added? The recommended system requirements below are what I use. If your system does, or doesn't, run properly please let me know so I can better get a feel for how demanding the experience is...
row.short_description: Explore the Solar System! Stand next to the Sun and gain perspective for the true vastness of space beyond our home planet. You're in control of this virtual orrery. Fast-forward and rewind time itself as you highlight planetary orbits and discover a bit more about your nearest celestial neighbors.

row.name: Heroes Of Avranche
row.detailed_description: Enjoy the endless fun in endless dungeons! Uncover the truth about the destruction of the Guild and rebuild it from the ashes. Embark on epic, hand-crafted adventures as well as the random ones! Gather the best gear and defeat the toughest monsters and become the Hero of Avranche! Heroes of Avranche is not your run of the mill action RPG. You do not pick a class in this game, you are all classes! You can swap between classes by pressing a button! And, on top of that, for every class you have two stances that you can also swap between, changing your play-style in an instant! Heroes of Avranche features: thousands of randomly generated items dozens of abilities both active and passive dozens of monsters, each with their own unique abilities and many, many environments. When you chose to embark on an adventure you can pick your own difficulty and your own length. Random adventures last from 15 minutes all the way up to several hours while the hand-crafted ones take from 6 to 8 hours. Upon finishing an adventure you bring back materials required to upgrade your guild! Upgrading the guild gives you access to more and more hand-crafted adventures! Don't worry! We have plans for the future! And they are as follow: (these features are not implemented but are being worked on at the moment) Multiplayer Special adventures User-generated content More character customizations More hand-crafted adventures More environments More quests and lore
row.short_description: Enjoy the endless fun in endless dungeons! Uncover the truth about the destruction of the Guild and rebuild it from the ashes. Embark on epic, hand-crafted adventures as well as the random ones! Gather the best gear and defeat the toughest monsters and become the Hero of Avranche!
row.notes: Yes, the killing of enemies, bones exploding and enemies flying everywhere are a thing in this game. If that is something you may find offensive you may not like this game.

row.name: 1001 Hugs
row.detailed_description: Christmas Edition Ready to save Christmas? This is not just an update of 1001 Hugs three years later. It's a huge improvement of the game story, new Features map, achievements, leaderboard, 11 new challenging, fantastic levels, and more. The game will be released October 26, 2022. Easter Adventure Plans We are launching a Kickstarter project to develop a new theme of the game. About the Game 1001 Hugs, version 2, has a new game story. Now you are in Elfland with a special mission to collect Christmas presents throughout 16 levels and bring them to Santa. To pass levels you need to open portals; to do that you hug 4 key elves, and in return they get a candy cane. But you have only 1001 candy canes. Elves try to stop you by making you lose them before you reach Santa! Some elves just refuse to hug. You have to come up with a hugging strategy to get to Santa with gifts and leftover candy canes. It's an adventure with lots of hugs, pitter patter of little feet, laughter and giggles, slamming doors, flying teddy bears, bursting water balloons, and slippery puddles! New in this version: + Game story + 11 more beautiful and challenging levels + Features map with detailed game rules + Multiple achievements + Scoring and leaderboard + Character customization + Player's outfits, hats, teddy bear launchers, and packsacks This free to play, kid friendly single player TPS requires concentration, teaches hand-eye coordination and memorizing color patterns. It's made for children, their parents, and anyone who loves action, fun and laughter. Be silly and enjoy hugs! Please note: this game still contains collision bugs. We're still working on them. SPECIAL THANKS and GRATITUDE to: Unreal Engine and ThirdPersonShooterKit Epic Games Store and their reative contributors Tutorials: Unrealty Simon,Unreal Engine Rus, Virtus Learning Hub and others : MadTurtleGGinin,Thompson13 Forum members: Ikav, Ego, and others Designers: ProtonStudio, Tahira, DinVStudio Level Designers: Pedro Gutierrez, Andrew Syrbu Developers: Ivan Epifanov, Artur Dworaczek Free music: Zagi2, Setuniman, Nesrality, and others Bloggers: Bubble Knight, Fluffey Panda's world, Catalysts Gaming, Rexy XOX, Gaming with Aditi, Quiin Gaming, Manner, Affari Firdaus Steam Reviewers: MtWooderSheep, illious, Armagdo, Legend27, Newyearseve1971, and others Kickstarter Backers: Mike Howdy, Barbara Nichols Chief Editor: Victor Dull 1001 Hugs created in 2019 Updated October 2022 Credits: Desert2 by PeriTune | Music promoted by Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License Wind Chimes, A.wav by InspectorJ ( of
row.short_description: Kid friendly action game - to bring Christmas presents to Santa. For a low poly 3D shooter it has a unique gameplay. You have to hug key elves and deal with mischief ones to pass through levels. 1001 Hugs has a new game story, more levels, achievements, leaderboard, and character customization.
row.reviews: “What an awesome game! This is such a breath of fresh air after seeing all the rest of the ultra violent first person shooters. Especially in today's climate, I really think this will appeal to both kids and parents looking for a fun, non-violent video game. Great Job! Can't wait to play!!” Ijaz Ahmad

row.name: Flinger Tactics
row.detailed_description: Flinger Tactics is a turn-based strategy sports game where you fling your team of cute creatures to victory! The sport of Flingball is played like a combination of billiards, air hockey, and soccer where you'll fling athletes to break bumpers, tackle opponents, and score goals! As the coach of your squad, each turn you'll need to evaluate the field and determine which fling will bring you closer to victory. Scoring is always a good choice but when you can't you might consider making a substitution, repositioning, or utilizing one of your athlete's unique abilities. Fling strategically! Each athlete class has a unique shape and ability. Some are defensive and can restore your protective bumpers, while others can frustrate the other team by knocking your opponents unconscious. With each fling you're altering the state of the field and often if you're not careful there will be unintended consequences. Nothing is worse than scoring an own goal! Fling for fun! The flingers love nothing more than competing in the sport of Flingball! Watch the happiness on their faces as they fling around and react to the results of your fling and listen to their silly quips. Each flinger has a unique personality. Some are optimistic and encouraging, others are pessimistic and unconfident, and of course there's plenty of trash talkers. Play the way you want! All the rules including athlete, bumper, and ball counts are completely customizable so you can decide the best way to play Flinger Tactics. Each flinger has a unique ability, personality, and appearance and every team that they play for has their own colors, name, and motto for a highly replayable experience. Compete in tournaments! Play 4, 8, or 16-team tournaments against friends or computer-controlled teams to determine which team is the greatest of them all. Mess around in Free Play! In this practice mode, there's no turns and no end to the madness. Fling your athletes with reckless abandon and watch the chaos unfold!
row.short_description: Flinger Tactics is a turn-based strategy sports game where you fling your team of cute creatures to victory! The sport of Flingball is played like a combination of billiards, air hockey, and soccer where you'll fling athletes to break bumpers, tackle opponents, and score goals!

row.name: Eidolon
row.detailed_description: In Eidolon, you start as a new student at Eidolon University. You're asked to introduce yourself to the new students. In doing so, you'll learn more about them, the true nature of the university, and yourself. Eidolon University has a 2-3 hour playtime but no two playthroughs will ever be the same due to extensive dialogue options and as many as sixteen unique endings per character. You play as a new student at Eidolon university. As you interact with the other students (by clicking on them in whatever order you choose), you will have extensive branching dialogue options that unlock new areas, raise affection, and unlock special endings. This download includes the full game, free to play, with no additional content expansions anticipated. Play for free now and forever. Some of the characters you will meet while playing include: Erica (not-datable) – A bubbly sorority sister who'd love to party and make memories with you – or drink too much and forget them. Melody (datable) – She's hoping to save the world – and would love help picking up litter or protesting the new power plant, especially with an attractive student like you! If only she could find a way to graduate from the university and make a more meaningful impact... Vivian (datable) – Voted most likely to succeed. She'll apply that same ambition in dating you and in trying to escape from Eidolon. Adrianna (datable) – The resident romantic, hoping to have her own happily ever after. Can you give her the romance she longs for or will she be forced to take matters into her own hands? Brooke (datable) – Athletic and skeptical about love – can you work your way into her heart? Or better yet, give her the adventure she craves? Claire (datable) – Curious about everything, she's eager to experiment with you in all kinds of ways. But her greatest experiment will be determining the true nature of her world. Reia (datable) – More interested in books than romance, can you find a philosophy that incorporates love? Or one that explains who - what - she really is? Sophia (non-datable) – The school's guidance counselor may have answers to the mysteries of the university – or at least towards better understanding why you seek them.
row.short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to exist merely for the purpose of entertaining someone else? Have you wondered whether, since a purpose was programmed into you, you should pursue it, even if it seems wrong? Talk to the ladies of Eidolon University to learn their thoughts.

row.name: Zombie Season
row.detailed_description: Zombie Season has hit Pine City, are you the rookie cop that has the guts to save it? Experience an Open World and try your hand at survival in the plague ridden city. Get locked and loaded, jump in your police car and roam the streets to exterminate the zombie presence. Fly helicopters, find new weapons, and do what you can to make it out alive. Can your survive Zombie Season? Recent Changes: Open World Update - Free Roam and Drive cars Open World Update - Fly Helicopters AKs, Water Ski, Hat and Explosives Roadmap This next month: Open World Improvement Long Term: Steam Cloud Saves 10+ guns total 10 enemy types Greater enemy variation More scattered usable items
row.short_description: Zombie Season is an Open World FPS, made for Oculus Rift. Walk, drive or fly around Pine City, find some weapons and try to stay alive!
row.notes: Shooting Zombies

row.name: Anomaly Zone
row.detailed_description: This is a story of human pride. Time is at hand when, in their utter desire to study the world, people will start destroying it. Tests of high-energy heavy particles accelerators will result in billions of microscopic black hole rupturing the structure of time and space. This will become the point of no return. A counter-strike from nature itself will follow and the Earth as we know it will cease to exist. This is a story of human strength and true heroes. Three generations after the apocalypse, not only did humankind survive in the man-made hell – it continued to develop. Gradually, the infrastructure restored, wars stopped, people were returning to normal life. However, the crippled nature was barely starting to fight back... So-called anomalous activity zones started appearing all over the planet, like terrifying scars left by the man-made catastrophes. The vast territories of post-apocalyptic world live their own life, which looks like nothing you have seen before. Bloodthirsty mutated monsters, inexplicable phenomena, mysterious anomalies are but the tip of the iceberg. One of the Zones was formed in the vicinity of Ukraine, in an area combining the unmistakable atmosphere of Soviet times and the fast pace of modern life. In order to contain the dangers of the Zone, the government decided to fence the perimeter, and introduce quarantine in the area. Local residents found themselves trapped and left to their own devices. However, forbidden fruit is always the most enticing. And this was when the 'stalkers' came in. Mystical artifact hunters, former military men, explorers, adventurers, armed gangsters, mafia and just those who love getting away with shooting live targets – they swarmed in like locusts in Egypt to lead mortal combat with monsters and humans alike. This is a story about YOU. There is a non-stop battle between stalkers' clans, between aliens and locals. You can support any side or remain a free shooter. You can give a dota tion to your mates as a leader or take every loot to yourself. And if you don't want to lose your life in a proxy war, there is a PvE server and safety zones. You can shape your own story in the Zone. Who will you become? Over 40 square kilometers of lands to explore, from closed science villages and abandoned military facilities, to the forests of Tunguska and snowy deserts of Novaya Zemlya. Deadly mutants, anomalies and hundreds of main story quests. Huge choice of artifacts, gear and weapons. Repair broken things or assemble new gear from scratch. Improve dozens of skills and abilities. Be a doctor, a scientist, a hunter, a soldier or an engineer. Take part in mass PvP, bring death or salvation to those around you. This is the Zone. Come to hell and make it your home.
row.short_description: Anomaly Zone is an open world MMORPG and a post-apocalyptic shooter. Be a scientist, a soldier, a hunter or an engineer. Explore anomalous territories, search for artifacts, fight mutants and other players. Participate in mass PvP and PvE battles. The Zone is waiting!
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

row.name: Last Shark Standing
row.detailed_description: Last Shark Standing is an award winning, couch-play party game where you use your superior fishing skills to throw other players out of the arena, competing to be the last shark standing. The game features a unique hooking mechanic, hit a player and you will fling them behind you. Miss and you will be pulled to the location of your hit. Players can see where you are aiming and react accordingly, so you'll need to predict the opponent's reaction to outmaneuver them. The simple three-button control scheme makes the game easy to pick up for anyone, yet has enough depth to master. Features 2-4 player local multiplayer 6 arenas with unique themes and hazards 7 unique power-ups 7 different playable sharks For the best experience, we recommend using gamepads.
row.short_description: Last Shark Standing is a couch-play party game where you use your superior fishing skills to throw your friends out of the arena.

row.name: Lif
row.notes: There's violence in the game

row.name: Beach Body Bros
row.detailed_description: In a world ruled by Bros, one feeble wimp has what it takes to become the ultimate Beach Body Bro, and that pint-sized little runt is you! Showcasing Oculus Medium as a production ready sculpting tool, Beach Body Bros takes you on a ridiculous 4 minute musical journey through a world of pure muscle, intense strength, and stupid greatness. As you march along the sand your puny frail body struggles with the lightest of dumbbells, but with the support and blunt encouragement of a few wicked Beach Body Bros your body quickly beefs up until you’re transformed into the proudest of hulking meat specimens, glistening in the sun.
row.short_description: Embark on a ridiculous 4 minute musical journey through a world of pure muscle, intense strength, and stupid greatness.

row.name: Blackout Rugby - World Cup Edition
row.detailed_description: Join The Community On Discord About the Game Blackout Rugby is the most in-depth rugby management simulation ever made. Create, control and shape the destiny of your own rugby club in a quest for silverware and glory. Compete against friends and strangers in a massive multi-player rugby world, where your every decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Blackout Rugby is free to play, so download, create your club and take your first steps on the path to sporting immortality! Features Design and create your own player training regimes with 20+ different session types to fill them, along with proactive physical training where monitoring the progress of your players can pay big dividends. A balanced finance system that allows you to concentrate on the things that actually bring your club success whilst leaving the boring mundane money counting to your club’s board. An innovative card system that shapes what you can accomplish during a day, giving bonuses to those areas you want to prioritize, be it boosting a training session, improving a youth prospect, or strengthening a tactical aspect for an upcoming match. Anatomically specific injuries that present you with difficult choices about whether to rest or play players. Develop your club’s infrastructure, from training centers and medical facilities to building statues of past club heroes and broadcasting studios. Multiple tech trees for you to invest in to steal an advantage and shape the destiny of your club. Individual player avatars and multiple technical rugby skills and physical and mental attributes that make every player unique. A straightforward interactive contract system that allows you to negotiate the contract you sign with your players without getting submerged in multiple clauses and sub-clauses. Create and design your own match-day game-plans, taking advantage of your team’s strengths and targeting the weaknesses of the opposition, with a vast array of tactical options available, from attack patterns and ruck commitment, to kicking strategies and defensive systems and lineout targets. Set and save your line-ups, bring on substitutes from your bench and create positional depth charts to help organize your squad. A transfer market that encourages active auctions, but also allows you to make quick sales if you need cash quickly, or to pay well above the market value to ensure you capture the player you want. A youth academy system that allows you to take a raw talent and turn them into a promising young superstar. Unions, our take on clans/guilds. And much, much more! Coming Soon Union competitions. Cup competitions. Opportunity to manage international sides and take them into World Cups.
row.short_description: Blackout Rugby is a modern, multiplayer, social, world-class Rugby Manager Game! Take control of a novice club and sidestep and fend your way to glory. Take on people all around the world as you strategise, conquer the league, battle your way up the ladder, and build up your club infrastructure.

row.name: Divan Chronicles
row.detailed_description: Divan Chronicles should we sit on the couch while others decide the fate of Meme Power? Who will give us the wisdom to make the right choice? row.name: Nugget Royale
row.detailed_description: 🐔 Nugget Royale is a multiplayer battle royale game with chickens in a factory farm. 🐔 80 chicken players compete to be the last standing on an unstable disk above a gruesome grinder. The last player standing on the disk avoids being turned into a chicken nugget. Become #1 on the leaderboard and you'll be rewarded with a golden crown. Only one player can wear the crown, kings of the chickens. Nugget Royale has over 40 unlockable hats. Hats are unlocked by winning rounds in certain stages or by your amount of chicken nuggets. Nuggets unlock new hats, like a visor cap, ketchup cap, deep fry basket, and a drinking lid. Collect all the hats and show them to other players! Nugget Royale has over 14 stages with 4 different themes each with its own obstacles. Regular stage, this stage is all about balancing on the disk but be careful holes may appear. Freezer stage, the floor is extremely slippery, it's easy to push frozen chickens off the stage. Sumo stage, eat as much growth pills to push off the other chickens. Saw stage, dodge the saws or you'll be chopped into a headless chicken. Grab items before the other players and get a time-limited boost. Turn players into ice cubes, blow them away like a tornado or fly away from the danger! Compete with players from all over the world! Chaotic 80 player battles. It can also be played locally with up to 4 players on one computer.
row.short_description: CLUCK, You're a chicken fighting for your survival in a factory farm. Don't fall into the gruesome grinder or you'll be turned into a chicken nugget. The last chicken standing wins this crazy chaotic game. The winner wears the crown, making them the ultimate nugget master, king of the chickens.

row.name: Twists of My Life
row.detailed_description: Other games: About the Game Twists of My Life' - a visual novel where every decision you make can completely change the story. There's no 'game over' if you pick the wrong answer, but every choice you make will lead you to different outcomes in the many intertwoven plotlines. There are many beautiful, sweet, and sexy girls waiting for you. They will either love you or hate you... It is up to you and your decisions. Everything's in your hands. You are a law student at the University of N. You live a normal life; you study, meet different people, hang out with your friends, etc. In short, you do what most people of your age do. At a pivotal moment however you get yourself into trouble which force you to move, beginning a new chapter in your life and brings us to where the story begins. I worked hard on the personality of characters and the emotional aspect of the relationships between people in the game world. The sexual life of the main character hasn't been forgotten either however. All of the scenes are written in a vivid and descriptive manner, and are strengthened by good visuals. You will meet several different characters in the game, all with different personalities. Game features: - A number of parallel, evolving story lines - Beautiful graphics - Animated sex scenes - 17 endings based on your choices.
row.short_description: Twists of My Life' - is a visual novel where every decision you make can completely change the storyline.
row.notes: Our game focuses primarily on story, but please note that the sexual encounters between characters are graphic. There are very few violent scenes in the story, but some of them have dramatic outcomes, so if you are a squeamish person, we highly recommend that you do not play this game.

Become a hero of Moe Era! We count on you!
row.short_description: Welcome to Moe Era, the era of cute things! It has everything but a hero to help four adorable girls. You're the one they're waiting for!

row.name: EducationXR
row.detailed_description: EducationXR is an advanced 3D training and education platform. Making education visual and engaging, it enables educators to create, deploy and distribute their immersive creations to VR, mobile, desktop and tablets. A growing library of both free and secure private content is available for anyone to explore. If you are an educator, teacher, trainer or creator, custom content development and additional features are available with a premium license. Contact us at info@heizenrader.com to learn more! Cross Platform A core design principle behind EducationXR is its multi-platform support, enabling learners to experience any of the courses from the device of their choice, with all interactions and content automatically adapted to the control scheme of the platform being used, whether it is touch controls, mouse or tracked controllers in VR. While similar solutions may restrict you to a single platform, EducationXR gives you unrestricted freedom on any device. We believe that the best medium for learning is the one that you have with you at the time when you are ready to learn. This means that you can take all of the content available on EducationXR with you anywhere, and explore it at your own pace. EducationXR runs on VR, on Windows and Mac computers, and on iOS or Android mobile phones and tablets. The apps are simple to install and keep up to date from the marketplaces that you are already familiar with. Immersive and Interactive Content Activities and objectives for tracking and assessing user understanding. Click, rotate and re-size 3D objects of your choice. Label 3D Objects for easy highlighting even across multi-user sessions. Media attachments for supplemental information support audio, video, text, images or 3D animations. Simulate real world interactions with 3D objects for enhanced learning. Users can click, grab, drag, push and more. There are several ways for users to navigate experiences. Creators can choose from a guided linear step based structure or a non-linear “choose your own adventure” structure. Collaboration It has never been easier to collaborate with others. We've eliminated the barriers that exist when trying to connect with others using online software. Now you can connect with users from anywhere, at any time thanks to our cross platform multiplayer engine. This means that you can host a group session or join someone else's from any device, with voice controls for all attendees. Mix VR, mobile or desktop users in a unique session. Analytics & Heatmaps Full analytics in the admin web panel, with metrics to assess user's performance. 3D Heatmaps for VR users, analyze user's gaze directly from the admin panel and understand their behavior. Assessments EducationXR's assessment engine allows for you to easily measure and score what users have learned from your content. Authors can easily build assessments directly in the browser and deploy them to all platforms with the click of a button. Users can conveniently take assessments from any device, with the same functionality and ease of use. XR/AR Modes XR/AR provides a window into VR worlds from your mobile device of choice. Use your phone as a window into immersive worlds with complete spatial tracking.
row.short_description: EducationXR is an immersive VR, mobile and desktop learning platform focused on training and education. It's core concept is multi device support: Build once, deploy anywhere. Share lessons through our proctoring multiplayer services across devices or go through courses individually.

row.name: Grim Clicker
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST NEW GAME FROM ALEXANDR GOLOVKIN About the Game Grim Clicker is an IDLE/RPG clicker where you will find your own strategy to explore the lost worlds. Inspired by games such as Diablo, Grim Dawn, Dark Souls, etc., the game features a complex character development, many unique items, active and passive playstyle. Key Features: Skills - A large and clever skill tree provides a lot of ways for character development. Inventory management - You can improve your weapons, enchant them, disassemble them and create new ones. In addition to weapons, there are plenty of other items to help you on your journey. Ritual - If you feel your combination no longer works, perform the ritual and start over. Every time you will become stronger! Idle/Clicker - The character is immortal, so you can safely let him fight on his own, and only manage the general trend. Or, if you like to click, come up with your own strategy in this manner and help the hero on his way to knowledge. Shop - The shop of shards and black wax will offer you improvements that will sharpen your own style and increase the power of your hero. Chests - The rich chests contain masters' weapons, materials for crafting, potions, pets - in short, everything that the old masters put there. This is your support in the dark world of Grim Clicker! Cosmic Scale - The further you go through the game, the more possibilities you have. The new content implies new game strategies. Sound - Beautiful soundtrack and attention to sound. Mystery - Who are you? Why are you here? Look for the remains of ancient civilizations, travel through the desecrated shards, find allies!
row.short_description: Grim Clicker is an IDLE/RPG clicker where you will find your own strategy to explore the lost worlds. Inspired by games such as Diablo, Grim Dawn, Dark Souls, etc., the game features a complex character development, many unique items, active and passive playstyle.

row.name: 无限家园
row.detailed_description: This is a virtual multi-dimensional VR world. You can choose your own characters and equipment to take risks with your partners in the multi-dimensional world. You can participate in the battle of the end of the day. Can you find the portal to go home from the end of the zombie infested world? You can also guard the home core. The monster kingdom is sending troops to attack the game core and recruiting adventurers to guard it. You can also give full play to your creativity on your own island and build your own seaside villa. The ordinary difficulty of the game is suitable for normal games. After the game is over, it will be rated and rewarded according to the combat performance. When you have advanced weapons, you can challenge the nightmare difficulty and get more game coins. The game has a harsh death mechanism. If you die, your character will be reset and all the previously obtained game coins will be lost. Therefore, you must protect yourself when the game is out. If you can't hold on to the game, you can send it home at any time.
row.short_description: The game is designed in the way of infinite flow, with weapons, maps and missions of various combat styles. The game has two operation modes: keyboard and mouse and VR. After the VR device is connected and restarted, it will automatically switch to VR mode.
row.notes: The game map has scenes where weapons are used to fight zombies or monsters.

row.name: Dinosaur Hunting Patrol 3D Multiplayer Online
row.detailed_description: Hunting dinosaurs it’s a multiplayer online game whose target is to protect primates (our ancestors) of dangerous dinosaurs who walk from one place to another in Jurassic, Cretaceous and Triassic era. You have to keep alive primate who will be attacked for dangerous dinosaurs (T-Rex, Spinosaurus, Raptor, Triceratops, Brachiosaurus, Pteranodon, Stegosaurus, Dimetrodon, Paradophosaurus, …). You need another online cooperative player to help you to get the target. Points are shared for both. You will have many weapons, ammi and bullets to use for preserving primates alive. And you will have to keep you alive alone yourself. It’s a realistic game in 3D with free moving ad stereo sound. You will have missions with different difficult levels. And two differents worlds: last day and tropical forest. You will feel danger and feel responsibility for your life and that of others at all times. You can speak with your friends while you play this game.
row.short_description: In an ancient world (Jurassic and Cretaceous) when dangerous dinosaurs lived for hunt and survive. You have to preserve your life and our ancestors primates in this world. You will have much weapons to hunt and defend. With zoom you can be more accurate. In dark jungle you can use light to see better.

Most importantly, how will it feel like to be the un-known things? You start from a room with one painting on the wall. You will find out than your avatar changes each time you go into different rooms. The walls of the rooms are not like the physical walls in a way that it cannot prevent you from going through it. row.name: Freud Gate
row.detailed_description: 'Doors exist to isolate. You are the key, or rather, the one who can open the door.' Freud Gate is an interactive story game about the story of dream and redemption. Freud Gate, the 'door of heart' in the game. Players will play as a spiritual mentor and help the depressed girl to find a breakthrough. The game is divided into two parts: the real world and the imaginary world. It aims at making the player realize that only by truly understanding the depressed people can the player help them. The main gameplay is puzzle-solving and exploration. Each level in the game will have different puzzles, and only after solving the puzzle correctly can you enter the next level. Player's bad decisions may put the game into bad endings. 'I had a lot of bad dreams. Dreams are easy to forget, and I don't remember the ones I had. So I thought the moment of wakefulness would go away, but it didn't. It was still there, deep down. I don't know how to describe it, and can't see what it is, but only... an indescribable emotion. Like falling from the high, failed to struggle. But feeling released, and suddenly sinking to the bottom of the sea, suffocating. It's like a nightmare. I don't know what to do. Either opening the wound and feeling the pain, or watching the pain heal. I don't want to do this anymore... Please, somebody, help me.'
row.short_description: Freud Gate is an interactive story game about the story of dream and redemption. Freud Gate, the 'door of heart' in the game. Players will play as a spiritual mentor and help the depressed girl to find a breakthrough. The game is divided into two parts: the real world and the imaginary world.

row.name: Kowloon's Curse: Lost Report
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Kowloon City. In this stand alone prequel to Kowloon’s Curse, experience a world both mesmerizing and morbid inspired by retro aesthetics from the dreamcast and ps1 eras. You play as Tony, a henchman to a mafia group headed by the enigmatic figure called ‘The Inspector’. Get in fights, deal with Tony’s troubled subconscious mind and try to survive a life of crime in a surreal nightmarish world based on Kowloon Walled City. A Standalone prequel to Kowloon's Curse set several months before the start of the game. Explore three districts of Kowloon City, or stay at home and browse KowloonChan. Fight a diverse range of enemies in turn-based combat, each with their own weaknesses to exploit. Visual style inspired by Japanese adventure games from the late 1990s and early 2000s. Replayability: Different choices and paths will present themselves based on your character's stats, allowing for the game to be played multiple times.
row.short_description: Explore a surreal world inspired by Kowloon Walled city in this turn-based RPG inspired by Japanese dungeon crawlers from the late 1990s.
row.notes: Frequent references to drugs and drug usage, bad language.

row.name: Breeders of the Nephelym
row.detailed_description: Enter an immersive beautifully erotic 3D adventure centered around catching and breeding the Nephelym, an enigmatic race of monster-human hybrids with an overwhelming desire to mate. Hentai First: Breeding System This game never forgets that its primary objective is to present you with highly erotic pleasing material. It's a hentai game first, and an adventure game second. On that note, every Nephelym breeding combination will have its own two-phase (penetration and climax) sex animation. You can control when the climax happens. There are a large variety of Nephelym, ranging from ripped and fit to fat and well-curved. All have been given 'interesting' genitalia to make for unique breeding animations. There are currently a few known species, but more are certain to be discovered. Lastly, any true breeder knows that to master the craft you need to 'experience' your Nephelym for yourself. At any point you can breed with any of your Nephelym. If you're feeling compassionate, you can give your love to a lustful blessed Nephelym and allow them to release their desires, or they might surprise you instead. Ultimate Sex Adventure As the only one from the mythical human race, you can leverage this to become a Nephelym breeder. Catch wild Nephelym, breed them to produce offspring, and uncover satisfying sexual experiences with blessed Nephelym across the world. In addition to sex, you will find a deep lore and story behind this beautiful, but mysterious world. Dynamic Characters Written from the ground up to be dynamic and editable in realtime, each character can change shape, color, details, and attachments on the fly. All while sharing the same rig and animations. Not only does this allow for robust custom breeder creation, but it also opens up many possibilities for changing the shape of Nephelym through gameplay. For example, Nephelym can be fed certain items to make them fatter or more fit depending on your taste, this will visually change their bodies and alter their stats. Immersion There are no loading screens at all, no annoying cutscenes, and the camera was programmed from the ground up to be a seamless smooth transition between every mode. Features were added to increase control over your breeder--you can at any time remove all or particular pieces of clothing. You have control over the different phases of any sex scene, and complete freedom with camera movement and speed. To further immersion, graphical beauty is a priority. Lighting is high quality and lots of foliage is used with many characters having dynamic realtime fur.
row.short_description: Enter an immersive beautifully erotic 3D adventure centered around catching and breeding the Nephelym, an enigmatic race of monster-human hybrids with an overwhelming desire to mate.
row.notes: This game contains full body nudity, erotic dialogue, and consensual sex acts for the purpose of reproduction and pleasure. All characters are 18+.

row.name: Funny Archery
row.detailed_description: In Funny Archery, the player will be stand at the watchtower to have an overview of the entire map. However, there will still be blind spots which make the game more challenging. Help the soldier complete his mission by pulling the bow, aiming and making sure the arrow hit the target. The game will have 3 maps that equal to 3 different playing modes Map 1 : (game mode TOWER DEFENCE) Player will stand on a tower near the gate, defend against attacks of the enemy and prevent them from entering the gate. The level of difficulty will be increased gradually with each wave, along with a variety of moves and protective armor. They can move normally, fly in the air, jump from point to point, or launch very quickly when approaching the gate. This map will have a total of 10 waves. If the defense succeeds after 10 waves, the player will unlock the next stage. It is temporarily called map 2. Map 2 : (game mode ARENA DeathMatch 1vs1) This is a solo arena map. In this map, player and enemy will stand on both sides of the arena. In each round, there will be an enemy, the level of difficulty will increase gradually after each round with their variety of moves and fight. Player will hold a bow, attack the enemy, and defend against enemy's arrows. The enemy's attack frequency will increase gradually, at the same time, the stun duration will decrease after each turn, the movement speed of the enemy will also increase gradually, they can jump, change their speed, and suddenly change direction to cause difficulties for the player, those things will make player very busy to be able to defeat the enemies. Map 3 :This will be the last map, player has to survive by eliminating the normal enemy. After passing this challenge, the player will confront the final boss of the game. It will attack the player with a cannon. Player is unable to attack it in a normal way, but has to take advantage of its explosive shells, attack them before they are fired, make the boss fall into a stunned state, and then the player can attack, damage and destroy it. The variety of boss’ attacks will make it difficult for the player to defend and attack properly. This final battle is also the end of the game, marks the success of defending the fortress from enemy invasion.
row.short_description: In the role of a brave and clever soldier, your mission is to protect the wall from enemy attacks till your last breath with a bow as the main weapon. The enemies become increasingly dangerous through each wave, so you must keep focusing on each shot to ensure no enemy will pass through the wall.

row.name: Rise Of The Overlords
row.detailed_description: Rise of the Overlords is an online multiplayer game that combines collectible card games (CCG) with board strategy games. Build your deck, command your army, and challenge other players in epic combats on stunning dynamic battlefields. Rise of the Overlords is completely free and learning how to play will only take you 5 minutes! Choose an Overlord with unique abilities to represent you on the battlefield. Build your deck with powerful units, spells and equipment. Strategically summon and move your units on the stage. Every square matters! Fight epic battles in dynamic battlefields: Destructible walls, explosive barrels, lava, blizzards... Develop your strategy to adapt to your opponent and the battlefield. Each of the factions in Rise of the Overlords has its own synergies and playstyle, although all of them can be combined with a wide range of neutral cards to create countless different strategies. For now, there are three factions available, but in the future two more factions will join the fight. Choose the faction that best represents your play style: The Feral Tribes focus on brute force and direct combat. They have ways to deal huge amounts of damage in exchange for damaging their own units, but they also have powerful units that benefit from taking damage! The Sons of Erendriel focus on performing fast, fluid combos while keeping the opponent at bay with powerful disabling spells and slippery units, waiting for the perfect moment to deliver the final blow. The Kingdom of Amerald does not have very powerful units, but its battalions are unstoppable thanks to their healing spells and powerful defensive equipment! There is no one who wins them in battles of attrition.
row.short_description: Rise of the Overlords is an online multiplayer game that combines collectible card games (CCG) with strategy board games. Build your deck, command your army, and challenge other players in epic combats on stunning dynamic battlefields!

row.name: Warren The Warlock
row.detailed_description: Warren the Warlock is a 2D platformer in which you jump, throw, flip, phase, and dash your way through enemy filled levels to progress. Your ultimate goal is to find and defeat the leader of the unwelcome guests who have found their way into your homeland. Ridding your home of these intruders will not be an easy task, but as a warlock, you have a few tools at your disposal to help you along the way: Magic Orb: Hurl your dark magic orb at enemies. Be careful though, not all enemies are affected by your magic. Invert Gravity: Keep an eye out for areas with a special shimmer in the air. When you find one, you can reverse gravity for yourself to find new and creative ways forward. Phase Shift: Become intangible to certain materials. This allows you to walk through certain walls, floors, objects, etc. Dash: Gain an instant burst of speed, allowing you to speed past obstacles and break through weak walls. With the use of these magical abilities and a few other items you will find along your way, you are fully prepared to face the challenges ahead… or are you?
row.short_description: Get ready to venture out as Warren, the ominous-looking warlock. Hurl your magic orb, invert gravity for yourself, and phase shift through walls. Fight your way to the leader of the invading horde in hopes of liberating your realm.

row.name: The Climate Trail
row.detailed_description: Survive and stay alive as climate change ravages the earth! Escape to a more hospitable location with the limited resources you have and increasing heat scorch your homeland. Do you have the necessary survival skills to reach your destination before your time and resources run out? Join us in this thrilling, RPG adventure now! What is climate change and how does it happen? How does climate change affect the world, especially in America? You can learn all about it while playing this RPG adventure game. You can learn the devastation that is caused by climate change and how it turns an area that was once green into inhabitable places for humans. Wildfires are getting wilder, the land is completely dry, and there is no water to be found. Your entire home and the surrounding area has become a wasteland. It feels like it’s apocalypse now! It might even be the last day on Earth. Your only hope is to flee to Canada where the land is still lush and green. === FEATURES OF CLIMATE TRAIL: === ● 100% FREE and NO ADS! Our aim is to educate people while telling a compelling storyline and engage you in an addictive RPG adventure game. That’s why this game is totally FREE and without ADS! Immerse yourself in this post-apocalyptic world with no distraction. ● IMMERSIVE STORY AND GAMEPLAY Experience what it feels like to be one of the few survivors in a very inhospitable environment. Learn how to survive in the most dire situations. Know how to use very limited resources to stay alive and make the journey to your destination. You will feel every desperation, urgentness as your resources grow less and less. and joy when you successfully face the challenges on the way. You will also feel and learn about how climate change will affect every last human being on the planet. ● GREAT CHALLENGES Maybe you’ve played a lot of survival and shelter building games. Even if you are a seasoned player, you will still need to think and strategize to be able to make it alive in this game. If you are a beginner in survival games, don’t worry. It will be a great way to learn tactics, strategies, and exploring all possibilities. Climate Trail is a great game to train your problem-solving skills. ● EDUCATIONAL GAME Our mission is to educate everyone about the cause and the effects of climate change. You will learn the scientific facts about what’s currently happening to our earth. Then, we hope you use the knowledge to change your habits and lifestyle to prevent the condition becomes worse much faster. ● GREAT GRAPHICS AND GAME DESIGN Climate Trail is created by an industry veteran who was the technical producer on such classics as 'The Return To Zork,' 'The Pyramid of Peril,' and some of the first mobile games. We worked hard to make sure this game has a great graphic and enjoyable to play. So, what are you waiting for? Are you ready to play as a climate refugee and survive all the obstacles? Download and play Climate Trail NOW!
row.short_description: The Climate Trail is about climate refugees fleeing ever-worsening conditions after inaction on climate has rendered much of the USA (and the world) uninhabitable. The game combines the adventure and play of the journey north with visual novel elements.
row.reviews: “An amazing remake of The Oregon Trail. Where the original did not mince its words 'Your daughter died of dysentery', this game did not get any less harsh. It feels like in a time when modern games are all about popping bubbles or crushing candy, this game can feel a little jarring, a little bit like a pinch in the face with reality, or at least one possible future reality. But that's the point of this game. It is still a great way to have fun and fiddle away some time!” 5/5 – Android User “I think this is awesome. Kudos to you for making a simple and clean game. This was full of great information and humor; I loved the Rideshare bit. I hope someday that I can make a game as good as this one. Thank you for putting the time into this and letting us give it a try.” 5/5 – Windows User “I played for about 15 minutes and died of starvation on easy. 10/10 would recommend people play this game.” 5/5 – Windows User

row.name: Split or Steal
row.detailed_description: Split or Steal is a light re-imagining of the Game Theory concept of The Prisoner's Dilemma . Two players will be selected from a pool of online users, and are presented with a potential reward. The players are given a maximum of 2 minutes to speak with eachother – at which point, they can then choose to either share, or attempt to steal the reward. Earn an honest fortune, or steal your way to success - then spend your winnings on building a Headquarters to amplify your earnings in an idle/incremental-style fashion, running heists against those who wronged you, or just buying one of over 140 different cosmetics to show off in-game with. And, if you don't manage to alienate people by stealing from the entire planet, take advantage of the shared wealth and bonuses offered by joining an Organization! Fully cross-play compatible with all other Web & Standalone releases, inclusive of support for importing existing player profiles.
row.short_description: Have you ever wanted to devote your time and energy to amassing a small fortune, and then place total trust in a complete stranger to not steal it all away from you?

row.name: Oasis VR
row.detailed_description: Oasis is a virtual world where you make friends. What can you do? Go clubbing or hunting with your new friends, or watch movies or ball games in a pub. Plenty of FPS/Simulation/Puzzle games for you to play and meet new players. Also, you can build your private worlds and invite friends to share it with you. Join 'Oasis' to make friends and create your dream world! Features: Brand New Home System! Easily design your home with the new Oasis Studio. This will be a unique private space that you can cherish. Whether you want to work alone on your farmland or make good memories with your friends, it’s all possible in your very own home! Create Avatars without Limit! In Oasis, only you have the power to decide who you are and what you look like. You can be Lolita, a MechWarrior, Godzilla, and more! Anything you imagine can be transformed into your virtual avatar in the game. Real and Enjoyable Social Communication! Oasis applies full-space 3D audio chat for you to enjoy immersive social scenes with your own actions and facial expressions. Oasis embodies a truly social experience with a variety of facial expressions and body movements in its virtual world! In this world, you can find friends who are as cool as you are and talk to each other across borders. With so many different in-game scenes, making friends is a flexible and joyful experience! Full-Body Tracking! Use your VR devices for extra fun! Real social and virtual interaction tracks and captures your eyes, mouth, and body movements! Follow us on Discord for more product updates and Quick-find your friends! You can also check our “Create” site for instructions on how to create in-game.
row.short_description: Oasis is an amazing virtual environment where you can make new friends around the world! You can chat with them, play poker, go bowling, or even arrange a home party in several virtual worlds. You can also create your own avatars for you and your friends!

row.name: Wizards
row.detailed_description: Battle against friends and foes in all-out wizard warfare. Use the elements to crush your opponents, with various spells to choose from. Whether it's summoning the undead, freezing your opponents, or blasting your opponent away with fireballs, you can customize the way you want to play. Become the wizard you want, whether by summoning creatures to do your bidding, or casting spells to become a master of destruction. Tactically crush your opponents in a one-on-one setting, or team up with your friends in a matchmade round to become the ultimate strategy master. With a massive range of possibilities, no two games are the same.
row.short_description: Artillery tactics games are back! Grab some friends and get ready for an all out Wizard war! Create your own way of play with tons of unique spells to choose from. With randomly generated terrain and unlimited combinations, you'll never know what will happen next. Completely free to play.

row.name: A Random Maze 某个迷宫
row.detailed_description: 没有记忆的少年在陌生的医院中醒来。 我怎么会在这种地方……我是谁？这里是哪里？ 没有人能回答他，包括那个戴着奇怪面具的“人”。 我们能离开这里的。我能想起一切的！ 我们……能吗？ “对不起……我不知道。” 究竟哪部分是谎言，哪部分才是真实？ 关于本游戏 一款使用RPGMaker制作的传统解谜冒险游戏，玩家将以主角Des的视角进行游戏，在探索的过程中揭露过往，找回Des的回忆，并与你的搭档Pes一同逃离这个未知的地方。 游戏特色 *本游戏采用了大量的原创美术素材及音乐，并有着精细的程序设计。 *本游戏不含有战斗要素，玩家所需要的仅仅是前进与思考，推断出过往发生的事件。 *本游戏包含数十张CG，且每个结局都有单独的CG展示。 *游戏中有一定的惊悚和逃脱战要素。 *游戏具有多周目要素。 *单周目通关时间：2~6小时 出场角色 Despair 通常被称为Des，主角，有些优柔寡断的少年，为了取回自己的回忆而行动。 Pestilence 通常被称为Pes，面具十分显眼，言谈有些古怪，他到底是……？ ??? 暗中协助的人物？ ??? ……沉默的真相要从哪里得知？ 关于结局 含有 Bad End * 11 Normal End * 1 Crazy End * 1 Good End * 1 True End * 1 以及一些小惊喜或额外信息 ——————注意事项/警告—————— *请确保玩家本人年龄不低于13岁。 *本作中含有部分血腥、暴力及精神污染画面。 *本作含有LGBT相关内容。 *本作故事纯属虚构，和现实中的团体、事件。个人没有任何关系。 *本作中含有的任何素材（包括且不限于图片，视频，音频，程序等） 禁止商业使用或作为二次创作的主体使用；除此之外的任何非商业使 用，请联系制作组申请授权。 *关于游戏的微小提示* 也许在迷宫中搅局的人多了点，但是能够相信的东西也很多，请努力加油吧！ 如果对游戏内容以外的部分存在问题，推荐阅读游戏手册。 主要STAFF及玩家交流 程序/监制：在宙 音乐/音效编辑：Karane 策划/美术/剧本：Ebonbio 【玩家QQ群】824909239 另外 我们有推出本游戏的实体音乐原声集，具体情况可以从游戏主页中了解。
row.short_description: 一个忘记自己姓名与过去的人，在突然出现的神秘人物的帮助下，从一个空无一人的医院开始探索自己的过去。只有取回真实，才能从这里离开，即使……真相不像你所期待的那样，他也依然盼望着他的未来。

row.name: Haunted Gas Station
row.detailed_description: After a vehicle accident, a man is forced to check a nearby gas station for help, unaware of its ghastly resident. FPS Indie Horror where you use your phone's flashlight to help navigate the property, look for a key and interacting with the environment while trying to find a way to get back on the road. Just a classic low-quality indie horror game for a throwback to the earlier days of cheap games. Think of this as playing out a short creepypasta.
row.short_description: After a vehicle accident, a man is forced to check a nearby gas station for help, unaware of its ghastly resident.
row.notes: Violence, Corpses, Blood

row.name: Phucker in the Rome
row.detailed_description: It's a cold morning in the dungeons of Castle Moonshine and cyberized hunk Ryukaze and his many friends and foes are moping around in their cells, not remembering who they are or what they are doing there. Their wretched lives are about to change however when a mysterious psychopath approaches them with a diabolical plan. Could this all be the work of the School Held Back Program? Yes, it is. The gang soon find themselves hopelessly lost in the darkest corners of the dungeon, disillusioned but determined to survive. Only one question remains... What is the point of Phucker in the Rome? GENRE Roller Coaster Psychological Edge of Your Seat Visual Novel Thriller GAME INFO Use the mouse to navigate, make important choices and self-investigate. Be enthralled by the gripping story line with a twist ending that will have you reeling for days. PROS  Is better than Woods and Gulag.  Babes and hunks beyond your wildest imagination.  Will elicit 'gamer feels'. CONS  Is in good taste.  Makes sense.  Will increase your social credit score.
row.short_description: It's a cold morning in the dungeons of Castle Moonshine and cyberized hunk Ryukaze and his many friends and foes are moping around in their cells, dazed and confused... Their wretched lives are about to change however when a mysterious psychopath approaches them with a diabolical plan.
row.notes: Drug and alcohol use, violence, sexual themes, nudity, self harm.

row.detailed_description: Chameleon Gallery VR is an online virtual reality platform presenting contemporary art exhibition. In collaboration with various artists utilizing virtual reality as new media in making and presenting their works, Chameleon Gallery gives audiences worldwide a new space in experiencing contemporary art. No Exhibition Available. New Exhibition Coming This Fall.
